notes: Frozen 6A fitted ratios and controllers, paired held-out fleets. Speed and lateral references both time-stretched; dt unchanged. vy integrates lateral momentum with linearly interpolated speed within each RK4 step. beta_noacc isolates within-step scheduling from the omitted coordinate derivative. Primary robustness gate: nominal separation broad envelope, vy at both time scales, M4 beats M2/M3 by >=5% with positive paired bootstrap CI, all severities amplitude-feasible. Four-corner regime classification is a secondary diagnostic. No refitting, retuning, longitudinal force model, load transfer, or combined-slip tires.
